stateOwnerDisposition: The same single-writer DurableInferenceControl journal owns legacy records and native hosted request identity, local in-flight slot reservations, final-use-witnessed dispatch bindings and digest-only durable observations.
terminalObserverDisposition: The actual Agent-fenced App Server client supplies matching turn observations through a trusted in-process port. Missing tokens remain null; uncertain execution holds its local slot. Provider turn entry additionally requires kernel FinalUseAuthority admission, while owner health remains a separate runtime observation. This is not provider billing, economic quota or signed remote-worker authority.

operations.sourceSemantics: Pins explicit local in-flight slot capacity and exact request identity before provider contact. This NativeLocalSlotAdmission is not the target economic/resource InferenceReservation.

Persists interrupt intent without releasing an in-flight slot; acknowledgement is not terminality.

Persists actual matching terminal state, output digest and optional observed u64 usage without durable raw provider text; terminality releases a local slot, unknown execution remains held. Late usage can refine an observation without changing its terminal outcome.
